name: HeaderHashrateBox
description: Two-row hashrate cell for the dashboard's header strip. Shows the app-side and pool-side aggregate hashrate side by side. Values fall back to `—` when undefined; the pool row is dropped entirely when…
descriptionFull: Two-row hashrate cell for the dashboard's header strip. Shows the app-side and pool-side aggregate hashrate side by side. Values fall back to `—` when undefined; the pool row is dropped entirely when the site has no pool (see `showPool`)

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon shown next to the stat

props.name: showPool
props.description: Whether to render the pool row. Defaults to `true` only when `poolPhs` is passed, so a site with no upstream pool shows…
props.descriptionFull: Whether to render the pool row. Defaults to `true` only when `poolPhs` is passed, so a site with no upstream pool shows no empty `Pool —` row. Pass it explicitly to hold the row's space while the pool number loads, or to drop the row despite having one

props.name: fractionDigits
props.description: Decimal places shown for both values — defaults to `3`
